transactions.last_day_completeness: unverified; final day excluded from evaluation targets
transactions.quantity_policy: positive invoice quantities; returns/corrections are not abs() and are not latent demand
transactions.duplicate_policy: No unique line ID exists. Same document/SKU can have several real lines; these are not deduplicated.
transactions.duplicate_exact_policy: Exact repeated transactions are flagged for review, not silently removed without a unique line ID.

monthly_sales.availability_policy: A monthly value is available only after its month ends; publication delay unknown.

monthly_stock.availability_policy: A monthly value is available only after its month ends; publication delay unknown.

sources.filename: Ежемесячные продажи в кол-м выражении SystemElectric 2024-2026.xlsx

current_snapshot.inbound_eta_year_policy: Same year as dated snapshot; unverified assumption, never automatic year rollover.
current_snapshot.negative_quantities_policy: Retained and flagged; require review before procurement.
current_snapshot.warehouse_components_policy: Do not sum component columns or add them to Остаток: their accounting scope is unverified.

order_multiples.interpretation: Кратность means order multiple; minimum order quantity is not supplied.
order_multiples.conflict_policy: Use the separate Кратность export; embedded sales multiples are not silently substituted. Effective date unverified.

daily_monthly_reconciliation.policy: Monthly net reports and positive invoice targets have different semantics/scope. Never sum overlapping histories or replace daily labels with monthly totals.

seasonality.unit: not specified in the workbook; likely monetary, unverified
seasonality.feature: Dimensionless index from a complete prior year only; precomputed cross-year coefficients ignored.

notes: Monthly observations remain monthly; no fictional daily sales are created or added to daily transactions.
Monthly stock is a lagged proxy, not exact daily availability or proof of stockout.
Monthly publication/revision timestamps are unavailable. Point-in-time tests assume publication at month end; strict historical vintages cannot be verified.
Current category, stock, inbound, multiples and growth do not enter historical demand features.
Reported historical growth is not an independent forward growth forecast.
Category labels have no supplied meanings or service-level policy.
Current warehouse scope and the meaning/currency of СС реал require confirmation before cost optimization.
Client ID, selling price, daily stockout intervals, supplier lead times and material obligations are absent.
All six sources are read and audited; unavailable semantics are not invented to claim all requirements pass.
